messages:
marta: Quick sync — customer Epoch wants an explicit audit export format + per-tenant retention SLAs. Can we fold this into the compliance playbook for Q3?

sam: Do they require BYOK/KMS or is the priority immutable exports + retention? Their notes say 7y retention and an exportable, tamper-evident bundle.

jin: Ops question — full export with PII redaction + signed manifest will be heavy. Could we support incremental deltas to reduce cost?

neha: From legal: export MUST include chain-of-custody metadata and a verifiable signature. Also need a tenant-level TTL override flow for legal hold.

sam: Suggestion: two-phase approach to limit blast radius — Phase A (MVP): export schema + signed manifest + per-tenant retention flags. Phase B: BYOK handshake + KMS escrow + gated SOC2 evidence packaging.

marta: Sounds pragmatic. For the MVP, what are the concrete engineering gaps?

jin: Gaps: (1) ETL currently drops KV/cache metadata needed for proof-of-origin, (2) retention UI doesn't expose tenant overrides, (3) export pipeline needs signed manifest integration. Roughly 2 eng sprints to unblock if prioritized.

sam: Example manifest we'd produce (MVP):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t-epoch-123",
  "exported_at": "2025-07-12T18:22:00Z",
  "items": 124523,
  "hash_algorithm": "sha256",
  "manifest_signature": "base64(...)"
}
```

neha: I'll map this to SOC2 mapping A.2 / C.5 controls and confirm which evidence buckets are satisfied by the manifest + export. I'll post the mapping in the compliance doc tomorrow.

marta: Action items: @jin estimate PR hours and a minimal data-model change by EOD, @neha map SOC2 controls by tomorrow, @sam draft rollout + customer comms and an MVP runbook. If estimates look OK we'll slot into Q3 planning.

legal-bot: Reminder — please file a change request in compliance-tracker with the customer name, retention term, and export schema link.

sam: Will open CR-874 and attach the manifest sample + draft runbook.

marta: Thanks all — please ping if any blockers. :thumbsup:
